title: TrollsWithOpinion: A Dataset for Predicting Domain-specific Opinion Manipulation in Troll Memes
findings: The paper's models performed poorly overall on the task of classifying troll memes, which includes a category for memes targeting individuals or groups based on their religious beliefs. The best-performing machine learning model (Random Forest) achieved a weighted-average F1-score of 0.37, indicating the difficulty of this multimodal task. There were no specific findings broken down by the religious sub-category.
